declare
 temp_cust_id VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select customer_id into temp_cust_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = :product.s_customer_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and exists (select * from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id)
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into temp_cust_id
 from customers
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and upper(name) like :product.s_customer_id || '%'
 and exists (select * from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id)
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 list_values;
 return;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 :product.s_customer_id := temp_cust_id;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :Global.sav_customer_id := :product.s_customer_id;
 NEXT_ITEM;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is
 select customer_id, chapter_id, product_type,
 tier, from_day, to_day,
 unit_price, eff_date, term_date, last_modified_date
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where (product_type = :product.product_type
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and customer_id = :product.s_customer_id) or
 ((customer_id = 'STANDARD'
 and product_type= :product.product_type)
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and tier not in
 (select tier from product_pricing_matrix
 where product_type= :product.product_type
 and customer_id = :product.s_customer_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)))
 order by tier;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 --
 :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id := c1_rec.customer_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id := c1_rec.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_type := c1_rec.product_type;
 :ctrl_blk_1.tier := c1_rec.tier;
 :ctrl_blk_1.from_day := c1_rec.from_day;
 :ctrl_blk_1.to_day := c1_rec.to_day;
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_price := c1_rec.unit_price;
 :ctrl_blk_1.eff_date := c1_rec.eff_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.last_modified_date :=c1_rec.last_modified_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.term_date := c1_rec.term_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_number_days := (:ctrl_blk_1.to_day -
 :ctrl_blk_1.from_day) + 1;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_time_unit := :s_lifespan_ind;
 :s_time_unit := :s_lifespan_ind;
 :s_number_days := (:to_day - :from_day) + 1;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_old_price := c1_rec.unit_price;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_old_customer_id := c1_rec.customer_id;
 --
 down;
 --
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 --
 first_record;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select product_type, product_type_desc,
 life_span,decode(life_span_ind,'H','Hours',
 'D','Days',
 '','Years')
 into :product.product_type, :product.s_product_desc,
 :life_span, :s_lifespan_ind
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :product.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0322'); -- Invalid product type
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select std_price
 into :product.std_price
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :product.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null; -- need something here
 --message('no dat found');
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :product.std_price is null
 then
 begin
 select max(std_price)
 into :product.std_price
 from vserv_products
 where product_type = :product.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

begin

begin

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 

 if :unit_price is not null
 then
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_old_customer_id = 'STANDARD' and
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_old_price,999999) !=
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_price
 then
 begin
 insert into product_pricing_matrix
 (chapter_id, customer_id, product_type,
 tier, from_day, to_day,UNIT_PRICE,EFF_DATE, TERM_DATE, LAST_MODIFIED_DATE)
 values
 (:s_chapter_id, :product.s_customer_id,
 :product.product_type, :ctrl_blk_1.tier,
 :ctrl_blk_1.from_day, :ctrl_blk_1.to_day,:ctrl_blk_1.unit_price,
 :ctrl_blk_1.eff_date,:ctrl_blk_1.term_date,
 :ctrl_blk_1.last_modified_date );
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in inserting in product pricing matrix');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_old_customer_id != 'STANDARD' 
 then
 begin
 update product_pricing_matrix
 set unit_price = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_price,
 eff_date = :eff_date,
 term_date = :term_date,
 last_modified_date = sysdate
 where customer_id =:product.s_customer_id and
 product_type = :product.product_type and
 tier = :ctrl_blk_1.tier and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in updating in product pricing matrix');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --
 else
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_old_customer_id != 'STANDARD'
 then
 begin
 delete from product_pricing_matrix
 where customer_id =:product.s_customer_id and
 product_type = :product.product_type and
 tier = :ctrl_blk_1.tier and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in deleting from product pricing matrix');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 --
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := '5';
 commit;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 check_package_failure;
-- execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 clear_block;
 go_item('product.product_type');
 execute_trigger('key-next-item');
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error_dist('0600');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
